title: Target anchorable refs to resolve
description: A non-empty array with one entry per element to resolve into a target anchorable definition file. An entry is resolved from a snapshot ref ('ref') or from a natural-language description ('semanticDescription'), so at least one of them must be non-blank; ref kinds can mix in one array.

ref.description: Snapshot ref of the element: a driver ref from the rendered tree (for example 'e28'), or a CV ref from cv-tree.yml - 'cve<N>' for an element, 'cvw<N>' for a word - which requires a prior 'snapshot capture --type cv' and resolves into a CV-based definition. Ignored when 'semanticDescription' is non-blank; a blank value counts as absent.

semanticDescription.description: Natural-language description of the element (for example 'the submit button'). Resolves into a semantic-selector-only target without an element ref, and takes precedence over 'ref'; a blank value counts as absent.

definitionFilePath.description: Absolute path of the target anchorable definition file to write, with forward slashes (a backslash is a JSON escape). A relative path resolves against the CLI working directory, not --project-dir.

activityType.description: The activity the target is meant for; tunes the generated default selector. Case-sensitive; omitted or any other value means 'None'. See selection-activity-types.md for when to pick each value.

name.description: Name written to the created definition's metadata. Not defaulted for CV refs.

description.description: Description written to the created definition's metadata.

examples.name: Login Button
examples.description: Button that submits the login form
